label: Spatial pattern
purpose: Test if a population is clustered, random or spread among the tissue's cells
useWhen: Testing if one cell type is randomly placed, or placed alike in two groups

useWhen.text: After Neighbour graph: its cells are the tissue

notWhen: The graph holds only this population: there is nothing to compare against

params.label: Neighbour graph
params.tip: Its cells are the reference; random means spread like them

params.label: Populations
params.tip: Each is tested on its own against the graph's cells

params.label: Max distance (µm)
params.tip: Largest distance on the pair-ratio curve

params.label: Permutations
params.tip: Random relabellings for the test; 0 skips it
